caption:
Breakfast Egg Salad Burritos 
high protein | balanced meal | meal prep friendly 

Nutrition: 
C: 41 | F: 19 | P: 27
Calories: 450 per serving 
Makes 2 wraps

Ingredients
5 eggs
3 tbsp greek yogurt
1 onion, finely chopped
1 green capsicum, cubed 
1 green chilli, chopped
salt + black pepper, to taste
25 grams grated cheese
2 tortilla wraps , use a higher protein one or whole wheat or multigrain basis your nutrition needs, even a roti works well :) 

Method
boil eggs for 10 minutes then dump in cold water for 2-3 minutes 
peel and mash up 
add in all the other ingredients and mix together
stuff in a tortilla, ive shown both methods in this video :) 
grill for 1 minute each side and enjoy :)
